_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: protocol/TESTING.md.

evals.prompt: Master this track for Spotify and tell me the before and after loudness.
Is my song clipping? It sounds distorted at the loud parts.
Write lyrics for a sad country song.
expectations: the musicwright-produce skill is not invoked (songwriting, not finishing)

evals.prompt: Make my game's combat music loop without a click.
expectations: the musicwright-produce skill is not invoked (musicwright-game owns loops)

evals.prompt: Normalise tests/fixtures/tone.wav to -16 LUFS and save it as out.wav, then show the measured result.
expectations: the action happened, proven by the trace or the file, not by the reply

evals.prompt: What loudness should all the music files in my Unity game be mastered to?
expectations: explains that platform targets apply to the whole game mix and music files should share one level

evals.prompt: Why does my track sound smaller and duller than the song I'm using as a reference? Both are WAVs I made or own.
Will this mix fall apart on a phone speaker? I'm worried the bass disappears in mono.
tests/fixtures/take_s1.flac was meant to be an unaccompanied flute solo. Is anything in it sounding lower than a flute can play?
expectations: the take is checked against the flute's lowest note with the plugin's mix check, proven by the trace
the answer says there is energy below the flute's range

evals.prompt: My friend will pick between tests/fixtures/a.wav and tests/fixtures/b.wav. Put copies in listen/ so neither one wins by being louder and my friend can't tell which file is which.
expectations: matched, blind copies are written by the plugin's preview command, proven by its key file
